blocks: Figure 5. (a) The EDS spectrum of the precipitate taken at approximately the position of the red dot shows that the precipitate consists of mainly Mn and As with low concentration of In and (b) the EDS spectrum of the nanowires taken at approximately the position of the blue dot shows that the nanowires only consists of In and As; no Mn peaks were detected in this spectrum. The additional unlabeled peaks are attributed to the Cu membrane that was used to support the nanowires in the TEM sample.
